shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books on weekends.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think it is to plan a trip in advance?
Q4: What tips would you give someone for effective travel planning?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: What are some of your favorite meals to cook at home?
Q2: Are there any difficulties you encounter with healthy eating?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of balanced meals?
Q4: What advice would you offer to someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any obstacles in maintaining a workout routine?
Q3: What is your opinion on the benefits of regular exercise?
Q4: What suggestions might you have for someone starting to exercise?
